items.title: My Morning Routine
items.summary: Find out what happens every morning in a simple daily routine that starts with waking up.
items.body: I wake up at seven o'clock every day. First, I drink a glass of water and open the window. Then I take a shower and put on my clothes. For breakfast, I usually eat bread with cheese and drink tea. At half past eight, I leave the house and walk to the bus stop. My mornings are quiet, and I like them very much.

items.title: A Beach Day
items.summary: Tom had a wonderful day at the beach last week with his family.
items.body: Last week, Tom went to the beach with his family. They took a bus and arrived early in the morning. Tom played with a ball and swam in the sea. His sister built a big sandcastle. They had lunch at a small cafe near the beach. Tom ate a sandwich and drank juice. After lunch, they walked along the shore and watched the waves. It was a sunny day and Tom felt very happy. When the sun started to set, they took the bus home. Tom thought it was the best day ever.
